t.E900.agn: In 2020 EFSA set an acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 17 mg/kg body weight and found no safety concern at the reported uses and use levels.
t.E900.body: Dimethylpolysiloxane is absorbed from the digestive tract only to a very limited extent; most of it is excreted unchanged in faeces.
t.E900.prod: A polymer produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E900.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI set at 17 mg/kg body weight/day (the previous 1.5 mg/kg was withdrawn); no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E900.summary: A silicone-based antifoaming agent. Prevents foaming in frying oils, fruit juices and jam boiling.
t.E900.what: Prevents or reduces foam formation (antifoaming agent).
